scene.path_case: same geometry as 128 rectangles, submitted as vector paths to a cropped isolated blur

retained.sparse_translation: one node per frame, translated 1/2 px alternately per 256-frame cycle
retained.dense_translation: all nodes translated 0/1 px every frame
retained.group_opacity: eight opacity groups, each with 32 leaves; one group changes 0.5/0.8 per frame
retained.sibling_reorder: first two siblings alternate move_before, with order-key rebalance during sampling
retained.insert_remove: alternate insert/remove extra leaf before first sibling
retained.reparent: one leaf alternates between two Group parents

mixed_sdf_pattern.callout_side: all four enum values, plus hidden tails
mixed_sdf_pattern.pattern: renderer and scene image IDs, all extend/sampling variants, opacity 128..255
mixed_sdf_pattern.timed: Canvas reset, recording background/layer, append child, render + wait; child construction and readback excluded

chunk_revisions.mutation: one immutable source Canvas replaced per frame; variants alternate per 128-frame cycle
chunk_revisions.paths: two/eight 10x8 translucent rectangle paths, four columns 6 pixels apart and rows 9 pixels apart
chunk_revisions.shared_vectors: 34x36 SVG source with 8x8 vector pattern; red/blue variants shared by all leaves; lowering excluded
chunk_revisions.text: one/four Noto Sans 12px Tileink runs, translated internally by (12,8) with append before retained placement
chunk_revisions.text_reference: independent immediate push_text_layout at physical origins for every live source variant, without append or retained materialization

procedural_brush.cached: reuse recorded Canvas and source instances; native brush preparation/rasterization still runs
procedural_brush.append: reset and record background, append reusable child at (90 + tick % 2, 70)
procedural_brush.shadow: append inside DropShadow with offset (6,8), sigma 3 and a procedural paint (phase 0.4); output region (80,60,1240,780)
procedural_brush.retained: 32 nodes sharing one 48x48 procedural rect at (4,4), radius 6, phase 0.8; grid 8x4 with spacing (120,150). One node transforms each frame; 1/2-pixel shifts alternate per 32-frame cycle.

protocol.order: same process; before/after and after/before alternate each pair; same executable for both complete rounds
protocol.repeat_reason: Four first-round procedural brush p50 values increased 1.33% to 1.74%; repeat all 29 cases with the same binary and preserve both rounds.
protocol.timed: NativeRenderer render and submission.wait; retained cases include transaction commit; append cases include Canvas reset/record/append. Parsing, shaping, compilation, construction and readback excluded.
protocol.pixels: Exact initial, first/second mutation and final baseline/cleanup readback for every case in both rounds. Nested text additionally matches independently recorded immediate references before/after each round.
protocol.control_interpretation: The primary two complete 29-case A/B rounds remain intact. Two six-case controls are separate diagnostics and are not merged into primary statistics: reversed construction order using the same renderer artifacts, then the same baseline renderer on both sides. Creation order substantially affects observed p50 differences; no speedup is claimed.
